mapper.insert: INSERT INTO follows (follower_id, followee_id, created_at) VALUES (#{followerId}, #{followeeId}, now()) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM follows WHERE follower_id = #{followerId} AND followee_id = #{followeeId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follows WHERE follower_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follows WHERE followee_id = #{userId}

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.avatar_url, (cf.follower_id IS NOT NULL) AS followed_by_current_user FROM follows f JOIN users u ON u.id = f.followee_id LEFT JOIN follows cf ON cf.follower_id = #{currentUserId} AND cf.followee_id = u.id WHERE f.follower_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, u.id DESC
